fullSource:
use IO.Std.read_line
use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line

// Seeded, so the transcript below reproduces.
let random = System.Random(7)

let target = random.next(1, 11)

write_line("I am thinking of a number between 1 and 10.")

do
    write("Your guess: ")

    let line = read_line()

    if !line? then
        write_line()
        write_line("No more guesses.")

        break
    fi

    let guess mut = 0

    if !int.try_parse(line, guess ref) then
        write_line("That is not a number.")

        continue
    fi

    if guess == target then
        write_line("Well guessed!")

        break
    fi

    write_line("Not that one.")
od
